<div id="crosssubsetting-sysml" class="section">

# CrossSubsetting <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#crosssubsetting-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">CrossSubsetting</span></span><a href="#syside.CrossSubsetting" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span> is a kind of <span class="pre">`Subsetting`</span> for end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>, as identified by <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span>, to subset a chained <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>, identified by <span class="pre">`crossed_feature.`</span> It navigates to instances of the end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>’s type from instances of other end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> types on the same <span class="pre">`owning_type`</span> (at least two end <span class="pre">`Features`</span> are required for any of them to have a <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span>).
>
> The <span class="pre">`crossed_feature`</span> of a <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span> must have a feature chain of exactly two <span class="pre">`Features`</span>. The second <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> in the chain is the <span class="pre">`cross_feature`</span> of the <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span> (end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>), which has the same type as the <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span>. When the <span class="pre">`owning_type`</span> of the <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span> has exactly two end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>, the first <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> in the chain of the <span class="pre">`crossed_feature`</span> is the other end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>. The <span class="pre">`cross_feature`</span>’s <span class="pre">`featuring_type`</span> in this case is the other end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>. When the <span class="pre">`owning_type`</span> has more than two end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>, the first <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> in the chain is a <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> that <span class="pre">`CrossMultiplies`</span> all the other end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>, which is also the <span class="pre">`featuring_type`</span> of the <span class="pre">`cross_feature`</span>.
>
> A <span class="pre">`cross_feature`</span> must be owned by its <span class="pre">`feature_crossing`</span> (end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>) when the <span class="pre">`feature_crossing`</span> <span class="pre">`owning_type`</span> has more than two end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>. Otherwise, for exactly two end <span class="pre">`Features`</span>, the <span class="pre">`cross_features`</span> of each the ends can instead optionally be inherited by the other end from one of its <span class="pre">`types`</span> or a subsetted <span class="pre">`Feature`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=74" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.4.6.2</a> of the KerML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=186" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.3.3.2</a> of the KerML specification.

Implementation of <span class="pre">`crossed_feature`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> The chained <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> that is cross subset by the <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span> of this <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span>.
>
> </div>

See section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=186" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.3.3.2</a> of the KerML specification for more details.

Implementation of <span class="pre">`crossing_feature`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> The end <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> that owns this <span class="pre">`CrossSubsetting`</span> relationship and is also its subsetting_feature.
>
> </div>

See section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=186" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.3.3.2</a> of the KerML specification for more details.
